unbounded.reason: Permissions depend on resources contained in the referenced Helm chart

description: Install (deploy) a Helm chart to create a release in the current or provided namespace

chart.description: Chart reference to install: a repository chart (stable/grafana), an OCI or HTTPS URL (oci://ghcr.io/nginxinc/charts/nginx-ingress), or a path to a chart directory or .tgz file on the server's host (unless allowed_registries is configured)

name.description: Name of the Helm release (Optional, random name if not provided)

namespace.description: Namespace to install the Helm chart in (Optional, current namespace if not provided)

rollback_on_failure.description: If the install fails or times out, uninstall the release again (helm install --atomic), so nothing is left behind and the name is free for a retry. Implies wait.

timeout.description: How long to wait for readiness and hooks, as a Go duration such as '45s' or '4m' (default '5m'). Keep it under your client's request timeout, or the outcome is lost.

values.description: Values to pass to the Helm chart (Optional)

wait.description: Wait until every object of the release is ready (default true). With false the call returns once the objects are created; follow them with the core tools.

name: helm_install
title: Helm: Install

description: List all the Helm releases in the current or provided namespace (or in all namespaces if specified). Use limit and offset to page the releases returned to you. Helm loads release secrets before applying that page, so a secret list that exceeds max_backend_response_bytes can still fail.

all_namespaces.description: If true, lists all Helm releases in all namespaces ignoring the namespace argument (Optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of releases to return. Omit or set to 0 to return every release Helm loaded. A full page tells you the next offset.

namespace.description: Namespace to list Helm releases from (Optional, current namespace if not provided)

offset.description: Number of releases to skip. Send the next offset from a full page, with the same limit.

states.description: Release states to list (default: every state, so a release stuck in uninstalling or pending is visible; Helm 3's CLI shows only deployed and failed by default)

name: helm_list
title: Helm: List

unbounded.reason: Permissions depend on resources contained in the installed Helm release

description: Uninstall a Helm release in the current or provided namespace

name.description: Name of the Helm release to uninstall

namespace.description: Namespace to uninstall the Helm release from (Optional, current namespace if not provided)

timeout.description: How long to wait, as a Go duration such as '60s' (default '5m').

wait.description: Wait until the release's objects are deleted (default true).

name: helm_uninstall
title: Helm: Uninstall
